title: Phasewise Prefetch Oracle for Kernel Hinting and Warmstart Microprobe
creator: Maya Singh
description: Add a lightweight phasewise prefetch oracle that probes a tiny microbenchmark at warmstart and uses a token-phase heatmap to select kernel variants for the prefill and decode paths. The goal is to reduce tail latency and unnecessary quantized fallbacks by creating a per-host / per-GPU-class kernel fingerprint cache that the runtime consults before dispatch. The microprobe must be bounded (<=50ms added to cold-starts), safe (non-blocking), and self-throttling. This ticket covers design, microprobe implementation, cache format, runtime integration to consult oracle during per-request routing, telemetry hooks, and a canary rollout plan. Outputs: functional microprobe service, kernel-fingerprint cache with TTL/eviction, runtime hinting integration, and dashboards tracking P50/P95/P99 changes and probe overhead.
acceptance_criteria: Microprobe daemon implemented and returns a stable kernel fingerprint within 50ms for supported GPU families
Runtime consults kernel-fingerprint cache and applies hint for prefill/decode kernel choice without blocking request flow
End-to-end P95 decode latency reduction >= 6% on the mixed conversational benchmark for 1.22 runtime when using oracle hints
No throughput regressions >2% on large-batch (reserved capacity) synthetic tests
Automated nightly benchmark produces per-GPU-family kernel fingerprint artifacts and uploads them to the artifact store

Implement microprobe: lightweight kernels, safety timers, adaptive sampling (owner: Eng-Perf)
Fingerprint cache: schema, TTL, eviction, signed metadata (owner: Infra)

PRs + code reviews and unit/integration tests
notes: Trade-offs: probing gives actionable data for kernel choice but adds cold-start overhead. We target <50ms to keep impact acceptable for latency-sensitive customers.
Scope limitation: first rollout supports Ampere/V100 families and models up to 8k tokens. We will extend to newer architectures after initial telemetry.
Cache location: prefer per-host local store with signed artifacts pulled from central artifact store for reproducibility and offline/private deployments.
Safety net: runtime must fall back to conservative kernel selection if probe missing/invalid or if latency delta exceeds safety threshold.
Sampling policy: default probe rate 0.2% of warmstarts; can be increased during experiments. Probe must be cancellable if request needs to proceed immediately.
Eviction/TTL: fingerprint TTL default 7 days with LRU eviction when local storage > 10MB per host. Allow manual pin from ops for sensitive hosts.
Metrics to watch: probe_latency_ms, probe_error_rate, hint_hit_rate, hint_improvement_p95, kernel_switch_count
comments: 2026-02-10 - Maya Singh: Created initial ticket after spike showed 9% p95 regression for certain prefills when kernel selector chose quantized kernels on Ampere. Proposal: lightweight microprobe that runs a small prefill+decode microbench to fingerprint best kernel.

2026-02-12 - Lucas Patel: Reviewed scope. We must ensure probe cannot increase tail latency for live requests. Suggest we implement probe as sidecar that runs only on host warmstart and expose hint through local IPC.

2026-02-18 - Priya Rao (PM): Customer use cases: enterprise customers running private deployments care about determinism. Need a config knob to opt-out of probing in Private mode and a signed artifact workflow for auditability.
2026-02-25 - Eng-Perf (comment): Microbench sketch attached in design doc. Initial measurements show fingerprinting completes in ~28ms on A100 with sequence 256 synthetic prefill.

2026-03-03 - Observability (comment): Added telemetry panels to dashboard; recommend rollout with 5% traffic for 48h and track hint_hit_rate and hint_improvement_p95. Threshold for rollback: hint_improvement_p95 < 1% or probe_error_rate > 1%.
2026-03-11 - Security (comment): For Private deployments, require signed fingerprint artifacts. We'll add minimal HMAC-based signing for now; HSM integration tracked in separate ticket.
2026-03-12 - Lucas Patel: Implemented microprobe prototype in runtime branch ENG-206412/microprobe; running internal perf jobs next 72h. PR link in attachments when ready.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal simulation with synthetic traffic and automated regression tests. Phase 1: Canary 5% hosted traffic for 48h, monitor probe_error_rate, probe_latency, hint_improvement_p95; rollback if error_rate>1% or negative impact >1%. Phase 2: expand to 25% for 72h if stable. Phase 3: gradual global rollout with opt-out flag for Private deployments. Post-rollout: weekly audit of fingerprint artifacts and nightly re-probing jobs in staging.
